basic_info.description: Situated in the coveted Franklin Square building amidst the vibrant Inner Mission district lies this sleek and modern 1 bedroom, 2 full bathroom loft. Private and flooded with light throughout, this two-level home features massive ceiling high windows on not one, but two walls and boasts an open floor plan with additional deeded outdoor patio space.The main living space boasts an open kitchen concept and flows seamlessly to the main living space and deeded outdoor patio, perfect for morning coffee or reading a book. Rounding out this level is a full bathroom, closet space and a full-sized in-unit washer and dryer. The second level is reached by a centrally located spiral staircase and features a large bedroom space with en-suite bathroom and gracious closet. This spacious designer loft totals 955 sq. ft. (per tax records) in a private setting with no wall-to-wall neighbors.Additional features include concrete floors, updated appliances, track and recessed lighting, 1 car deeded parking and storage. All this located just moments away from coffee, shopping, award-winning restaurants and public transportation.
